about: Every string the spelling map changed while building the Brennan's house: the research writes British English and the house is American, so each British form became its American spelling.

changes.before: Our house Champagne is a Piper-Heidsieck Extra Brut bottled under the Brennan's name, so it is drier than a standard Brut; a blend of all three Champagne grapes from the Piper-Heidsieck house. Piper-Heidsieck spells its own cuvee Essentiel. Say 'labelled for us', not 'made for us', until a bottle is checked, and do not quote a dosage or a lees age until the sommelier confirms which cuvee is in the bottle. The Binwise list of 3 October prices the bottle at $140; the current Bubbles at Brennan's page lists no bottle of it.

changes.before: Light-bodied Mosel Riesling from old vines: green apple, peach, slate and racy acidity. It is off-dry: a touch of sweetness, about twenty grams of sugar a litre, with only 11.5% alcohol and racy Mosel acidity, which is why it is our glass for spice and for the maple on the duck. The estate is at Ürzig in the Middle Mosel, a family with roots to 1510. Taste it at lineup if the vintage has changed.

changes.before: All Syrah from fifty year old vines on two parcels beside Châteauneuf-du-Pape, nine kilometres from Orange, farmed organically without certification; unusual in the south, where Grenache usually leads.
changes.after: All Syrah from fifty year old vines on two parcels beside Châteauneuf-du-Pape, nine kilometers from Orange, farmed organically without certification; unusual in the south, where Grenache usually leads.

changes.before: Lyre's non-alcoholic agave spirit from Australia, basil puree and lime, $14; Lyre's is labelled under 0.5 per cent alcohol, so call it non-alcoholic, not zero.
changes.after: Lyre's non-alcoholic agave spirit from Australia, basil puree and lime, $14; Lyre's is labeled under 0.5 percent alcohol, so call it non-alcoholic, not zero.

changes.before: Five courses. Wine pairing supplement $120, five 4 oz pours: Charles Lafitte Brut, Fichet Mâcon-Igé 2024, Louis Jadot Beaune 1er Cru 2023, Paul Hobbs Coombsville Cabernet 2021, La Tour Vieille Banyuls Reserva. Open the Jadot 20 to 30 minutes ahead, the Hobbs 30 to 60; pour the Banyuls before the Snickers lands. The current menu, pasted by the owner on 3 October 2026, prints these five pours and the duck with cane syrup-glazed peaches and candied hazelnuts, as the guide does. Read the printed card on shift. The pairing costs more than the food; do not apologise for it.

changes.before: Our wine director is Sam Bortugno, an Advanced Sommelier, in post since September 2023; confirm at lineup that he is on the floor tonight and how to call a sommelier to a table. Braithe Gill is beverage director for the Ralph Brennan Restaurant Group, a certified sommelier and a 2026 James Beard semifinalist; the research also recorded her as Braithe Tidwell, who led the programme when the Grand Award was regained in 2021, so do not call her the wine director.

changes.before: Brennan's has captains; staff train for months before cooking Bananas Foster tableside, and a new server does not flame a pan before sign off.
